title: 第10章 传说中的黑市
novel_title: 1960：九个妹妹把我宠上天(天下第九)
content_zh: “我跟他没啥关系，她跟常伟才是一对。”辰楠并没有过多解释，已经没什么意义。赵小川还想问点什么，但见辰楠不想说也不再询问。这种事情他还是不要掺和的好，说不定人家过过两天又和好了呢，以前也不是没发生过这种事。“小川，跟你打听个事。”辰楠搂住小川的肩膀，走到僻静处，“你知道哪儿能...弄到粮食不？你也知道我家人口多，那点定量粮食不够吃。”赵小川眼睛一亮，会意地笑了。“早说啊！我还以为你在为柳如意那点事烦心呢。”辰楠家里人口的确是多，九个妹妹，天呐，真不知道他爸妈生那么多干嘛。他四下张望一番，确认没人注意，才悄声说道：“后海那边有个‘夜市’，天黑两小时后开张，大概凌晨散场，想去要趁早。”“怎么能找到这个地方？”辰楠追问，自然只是这个夜市是指黑市。“入口有人守着，得交‘门票钱’。”赵小川比划着，“买东西的交五分，卖东西的交一毛。进去后别多说话，看中了就问价，谈不拢就走人，千万别纠缠。”辰楠拍拍小川的肩膀：“谢了哥们，改天请你吃饭。”赵小川嘿嘿一笑：“吃饭以后再说，有事尽管吱一声。”也就认识辰楠的时间比较长，否则这种事情他是不敢随意往外说的。告别赵小川，辰楠回家养精蓄锐。眼看爸妈快下班回来，他去厨房把稀饭与南瓜饼做好。做这两样东西时还加了不少灵泉溪水进去。就连厨房里的水缸都被他注满了灵泉溪水。爸妈下班回家见可以吃饭都夸赞辰楠懂事了，而且二人都直夸这次的南瓜饼与稀粥味道很香。他们自然是不知道辰楠在里面加入了灵泉溪水。一起吃过饭，辰楠端来洗脚水给二老。灵泉溪水不仅是给老爸准备的，老妈的那份也没落下。辰东南与李秀兰虽然没说什么，但已经笑得合不拢嘴。儿子长大了啊，都会给他们端洗脚水了。“孩子他妈，我怎么感觉泡完脚后那点余痛消失了？”辰东南很是惊讶，他的风湿痛比较严重，每次发作都要一个礼拜左右才能好。可这次泡个脚就感觉不到疼痛，儿子烧的洗脚水效果如此强大？？？“不疼还不好吗？”李秀兰也有些惊讶，想了想说道：“可能是血液循环，腿脚暂时不疼了吧。”“你还别说，这一泡我觉得浑身舒坦，一身疲惫一扫而光。”李秀兰觉得这是心理作用，毕竟这是儿子第一次给他们端洗脚水。“明天我还给你们端洗脚水。”辰楠满脸笑意，内服外敷的效果还是挺不错的。相信一段时间后，老爸的风湿也就会好转，老妈的身体也会更健康。“好好好，你小子有心了。”辰东南甚是欣慰，笑得眼睛都快不见了，儿子这孝顺直达他的心坎。三人闲聊一会，辰楠这才返回房间。夜幕降临。辰楠看时间还早，院子里的人还未睡。他意识进入空间，用灵泉溪水浇灌南瓜苗，南瓜果实长势疯狂。晚上九点多，确定爸妈睡着后。辰楠悄悄出门往后海方向走去。夏夜闷热，越靠近后海人越少，最后几乎看不到行人了。夜晚星光璀璨，还能看清周围的事物。辰楠一个闪身进入空间，再次出来的时候已经换了个模样。一身破旧的衣服，一块灰布蒙住半张脸，背后还背着一个很大的竹篓。竹篓里面暂时是空的，被一块布遮住，如果有需要他会从空间把东西拿出放在竹篓里。如今他这身打扮，即便是熟悉的人来了也不一定能认出他来。他来到赵小川说的地方，并没看到有什么黑市。他找了一圈后，在一个不起眼的胡同口，看到有两个汉子守着。终于找到了，辰楠立即快步走了上去。见辰楠过来，其中一人伸手拦住：“干嘛的？”“买东西。”辰楠压低声音。“五分。”汉子简短地说，还警惕地打量着周围环境，又看了看那高大的竹篓。还真是黑市，进出门票都要那么贵。辰楠掏出早已准备好的五分钱递过去。汉子接过钱，侧身让开一条路：“往里走，别大声喧哗，不可闹事。”辰楠点点头，走进胡同深处。拐过一个弯，眼前豁然开朗——一片空地上，居然聚集了数十个人！所谓的黑市，其实就是在几盏昏暗的煤油灯照明下，一群人默默地摆摊、交易。每个人都蒙着脸，看不清长相。整个市场静悄悄的，几乎没有人大声说话，偶尔传来几句压低声音的讨价还价。辰楠慢慢走着，观察着摊位上卖的东西。有卖棉花的、卖旧衣服的、卖布料的，但这些摊位前几乎没人停留。大多数人挤在几个卖食物的摊位前。可见很多人来黑市都是想要弄点粮食。一个摊位上摆着几个鸡蛋，摊主是个矮胖的男人，面前立着个小纸牌，上面用铅笔写着：“换米面，不要钱。”旁边另一个摊位上有些面粉，摊主是个妇女，她也立着牌子：“换肉或油。”辰楠心里一沉，看来这年头，有钱也未必好使，大家更缺的是实实在在的吃食。他继续往里走，发现角落里有个摊位与众不同——上面摆着几件瓷器、字画，甚至还有个小盒子里装着故意露出一角的小黄鱼。摊主是个瘦高个，靠在墙上打盹，似乎对生意并不上心。辰楠在他摊位前停下，看向那些瓷器。瓷器看着都是上了年份的东西，但是真假他可看不出来。不过那金子的真假容易辨认，这摊主是干啥的？是卖金子卖瓷器的？还是想要用换粮食？辰楠记下黄金摊主的位置，继续在市场里转悠。如今是艰难三年时期，这里大多数人都是以物易物，直接用钱交易的很少。而且粮食极其紧缺，偶尔有人拿出一小袋米面，立刻就会被人围住。辰楠在一个换布料的摊位前停下，掏出事先准备好的几毛钱：“同志，布料怎么卖？”摊主摇摇头，指指身旁的牌子：“只换米面。”辰楠无奈，只好继续往前走。整个黑市气氛压抑，每个人都在为生存奔波，却又不敢声张。微弱的灯光下，一双双眼睛里透着警惕和渴望。辰楠转了一圈后，来到一个鸡蛋摊贩面前。
content_en: "I have nothing to do with him, she and Chang Wei are a couple." Chen Nan didn't explain too much, it was meaningless.Zhao Xiaochuan wanted to ask something else, but seeing that Chen Nan didn't want to say anything, he stopped asking.It would be better for him not to get involved in this kind of thing. Maybe they will reconcile in two days. This kind of thing has not happened before."Xiaochuan, I want to ask you something." Chen Nan put his arm around Xiaochuan's shoulders and walked to a quiet place. "Do you know where I can get food? You also know that my family has a large population and the ration of food is not enough." Zhao Xiaochuan's eyes lit up and he smiled knowingly."I told you earlier! I thought you were worried about Liu Ruyi." Chen Nan's family does have a large population, with nine sisters. God, I really don't know why his parents have so many children.He looked around to make sure no one was paying attention, and then whispered: "There is a 'night market' over Houhai. It opens two hours after dark and ends around early in the morning. If you want to go, you should go early." "How can you find this place?" Chen Nan asked. Naturally, this night market refers to the black market."There are people guarding the entrance, and you have to pay the 'ticket fee.'" Zhao Xiaochuan gestured, "Those who buy things pay five cents, and those who sell things pay one cent. Don't talk too much after entering, ask the price if you like it, and leave if you can't agree. Don't pester." Chen Nan patted her.Xiaochuan's shoulder: "Thanks, buddy, I'll treat you to dinner another day." Zhao Xiaochuan chuckled: "We'll talk about it after dinner, just say it if you have anything to do." It means he has known Chen Nan for a long time, otherwise he would not dare to talk about this kind of thing casually.Farewell to Zhao Xiaochuan, Chen Nan went home to recuperate.Seeing that his parents were about to come back from get off work, he went to the kitchen to make porridge and pumpkin pie.When making these two things, a lot of Lingquan stream water was added.Even the water tank in the kitchen was filled with water from the spiritual spring stream.When my parents came home from get off work and saw that they could eat, they praised Chen Nan for being sensible, and both of them praised the pumpkin cake and porridge for being delicious.Naturally, they didn't know that Chen Nan added water from the Lingquan stream into it.After having dinner together, Chen Nan brought the two elders some foot-washing water.The Lingquan stream water is not only prepared for dad, but also for mom.Although Chen Southeast and Li Xiulan didn't say anything, they were already laughing from ear to ear.When my son grows up, he will bring them water to wash their feet."Damn it, why do I feel that the lingering pain disappeared after soaking my feet?" Chen Southeast was very surprised. His rheumatic pain was quite serious and it took about a week for each attack to heal.But this time I felt no pain after soaking my feet. Is the foot wash my son burned so effective???"Isn't it better that it doesn't hurt?" Li Xiulan was also a little surprised. After thinking for a while, she said, "Maybe it's because of the blood circulation. My legs and feet don't hurt for the time being." "Don't tell me, I feel so comfortable after this bath, and all the fatigue is gone." Li Xiulan thought this was a psychological effect, after all, this was the first time that her son had brought them foot wash."I'll bring you foot-washing water tomorrow." Chen Nan said with a smile on her face. The effect of taking it internally and externally was pretty good.I believe that after a period of time, my father’s rheumatism will improve and my mother’s body will be healthier."Okay, okay, you have a heart." Chen Dongnan was very pleased, smiling so much that his eyes almost disappeared. His son's filial piety went straight to his heart.The three of them chatted for a while, and then Chen Nan returned to the room.Night falls.Chen Nan saw that it was still early and the people in the yard were not asleep yet.His consciousness entered the space and watered the pumpkin seedlings with water from the spiritual spring stream. The pumpkin fruits grew like crazy.It was around nine o'clock in the evening, after making sure my parents were asleep.Chen Nan quietly went out and walked towards Houhai.The summer nights were sultry, and the closer we got to Houhai, the fewer people there were. In the end, there were almost no pedestrians at all.The stars are bright at night and you can see things around you clearly.Chen Nan entered the space in a flash, and when he came out again, he had changed his appearance.He was dressed in shabby clothes, with a gray cloth covering half of his face, and a large bamboo basket carried on his back.The bamboo basket is temporarily empty and covered by a piece of cloth. If necessary, he will take things out of the space and put them in the bamboo basket.With the way he is dressed now, even a familiar person may not be able to recognize him.When he came to the place Zhao Xiaochuan mentioned, he didn't see any black market.After searching around, he saw two men guarding an inconspicuous alley.Finally found it, Chen Nan immediately walked up quickly.Seeing Chen Nan coming, one of them reached out to stop him: "What are you doing?" "Buying something." Chen Nan lowered his voice."Five points." The man said briefly, still looking at the surrounding environment vigilantly, and then at the tall bamboo basket.It’s really a black market, and tickets for entry and exit are so expensive.Chen Nan took out the five cents that he had prepared and handed them over.The man took the money and stepped out of the way: "Go in, don't make any noise, don't make trouble." Chen Nan nodded and walked into the depths of the alley.After turning a corner, something suddenly opened up in front of me - dozens of people gathered in an open space!The so-called black market is actually a group of people setting up stalls and trading silently under the illumination of a few dim kerosene lamps.Everyone's face was covered and their faces couldn't be seen clearly.The entire market was quiet, almost no one spoke loudly, and occasionally there were a few words of low-pitched bargaining.Chen Nan walked slowly, observing the things sold at the stall.There were people selling cotton, used clothes, and fabrics, but almost no one stopped in front of these stalls.Most people crowded around a few stalls selling food.It can be seen that many people come to the black market to get some food.There were a few eggs on a stall. The stall owner was a short and fat man. There was a small paper sign in front of him. It said in pencil: "In exchange for rice and noodles, no money." There was some flour in another stall next to it. The stall owner was a woman. She also put up a sign: "In exchange for meat or oil." Chen Nan's heart sank. It seems that money may not be easy to use these days. What everyone lacks more is real food.He continued walking inside and found a stall in the corner that was different - there were several pieces of porcelain, calligraphy and paintings, and even a small box containing a small yellow croaker with one corner intentionally exposed.The stall owner was a tall and thin man, leaning against the wall and taking a nap. He seemed not to be interested in business.Chen Nan stopped in front of his stall and looked at the porcelain.The porcelain looked dated, but he couldn't tell whether it was genuine or fake.But it’s easy to tell whether the gold is genuine or not. What does this stall owner do?Are they selling gold and porcelain?Or do you want to exchange it for food?Chen Nan took note of the location of the gold stall owner and continued to wander around the market.Now is the three difficult years. Most people here barter, and very few people directly trade with money.Moreover, food is extremely scarce. Occasionally, if someone takes out a small bag of rice and noodles, they will immediately be surrounded by people.Chen Nan stopped in front of a stall selling fabrics and took out the few cents he had prepared in advance: "Comrade, how do you sell the fabrics?" The stall owner shook his head and pointed to the sign next to him: "Only rice and noodles." Chen Nan had no choice but to continue walking.The atmosphere in the entire black market is oppressive. Everyone is running for survival but dare not speak out.Under the dim light, a pair of eyes showed vigilance and desire.After Chen Nan walked around in a circle, he came to an egg vendor.
